lastCompletedStory.title: Suppress TabBar Left/Right while a ConfigScreen TextInput is focused

nextStoryContext: This PRD (issue CAM-316) contains only US-001, already implemented and passing. TabBar now takes an optional `suspended` prop wired to useInput's `isActive` option; ConfigScreen computes `textInputFocused` (customModel.phase !== null OR Global-tab fieldFocus 3/4) and passes it through. No further stories pending in this PRD.
